born-discrete.title: Amplitude sizes become probabilities
born-discrete.caption: After normalization, the two squared sizes are 1/5 and 4/5. The bars add to one. The imaginary sign in 2i is not itself a negative chance.

continuous-density.title: Width times height gives the chance
continuous-density.caption: The density is 5 per metre. The shaded 0.030 m piece has area 0.15. Its placement is chosen inside the uniform 0.20 m region.

interval-probability.title: The left quarter has less than a quarter of the chance
interval-probability.caption: The shaded area is about 0.0908, or 9.1%. The density is small near the wall. Position and density are scaled by the box length.

gaussian-state.title: Most readings lie near the centre
gaussian-state.caption: This bell is centred at 0.50 m. The shaded 0.30–0.70 m interval contains about 68.27% of results; the tails continue beyond the picture.

evolve-superposition.title: Relative phase changes the chance
evolve-superposition.caption: At phase π, the original plus outcome has zero chance. After a full 2π phase cycle, its chance returns to one.

expectation-variance.title: The average is not a third outcome
expectation-variance.caption: The only energies here are 2E₀ and 6E₀, with chances 0.75 and 0.25. Their average is 3E₀, but there is no bar for that as an outcome.

parity-bound-states.title: Opposite sides have opposite amplitudes
parity-bound-states.caption: The amplitude is zero at the centre. At positions +L and −L its signs differ, while its squared sizes match.

infinite-well-spectrum.title: Only certain energies fit
infinite-well-spectrum.caption: Dots mark the first four allowed levels. Energy grows with the square of the level number, so the gaps increase.

well-superposition-time.title: Position chances move between the two halves
well-superposition-time.caption: The left-half chance swings from about 92.44% to 7.56%. The total chance over the whole box remains one.

oscillator-excited.title: A zero at the centre
oscillator-excited.caption: This is position density, not an orbit. The first excited state has two lobes and zero density at the centre.

free-gaussian-evolution.title: Width grows while the centre stays still
free-gaussian-evolution.caption: At one spreading time, the initial 1 nm width becomes about 1.414 nm. This curve plots width, not a particle path.

hydrogen-ground.title: The radius distribution peaks away from zero
hydrogen-ground.caption: The peak is at radius a. Only about 32.33% of results lie inside a, shown by the shaded area. This is probability per radius interval, not density per volume.
